dcterms:description: A dataset comprising multimodal data of 564 patients, each represented by a 354-dimensional representation derived from imaging (MRI, fMRI, PET) and non-imaging (demographics and genotypes) features. The task is to classify each subject into three classes: ‘Normal Control’, ‘Alzheimer’s Disease’ and ‘Mild Cognitive Impairment’.
dcterms:title: Tadpole

dcterms:description: A dataset comprising multimodal data of 14,503 individuals, each represented by a 440-dimensional feature vector derived from brain MRI and fMRI imaging. The task is to classify the age group of the patient (50-59, 60-69, 70-79, and 80-89).
dcterms:title: UK Biobank

dcterms:description: A dataset consisting of 16,881 point clouds from ShapeNet, where each point cloud is sampled at 2048 points and annotated with one of the 50 part category labels.
dcterms:title: ShapeNet
